checks.consequence: Without UVs the mesh cannot be textured at all — not by a generator, not by hand.
Missing normals leave lighting to a renderer guess, usually reading as faceted or black.
A normal map without tangents is sampled against a guessed basis, so the surface lights wrongly in a way that looks like a shading bug rather than a missing attribute.
checks.expected: tangents whenever a normal map is bound

checks.consequence: Over budget costs frame time on every instance drawn.
Each material is a separate draw call unless the pipeline batches them.
Under-resolution textures blur under close inspection and cannot be sharpened later.
checks.expected: every texture at least 512px on its shortest edge

checks.consequence: Non-power-of-two textures can lose mipmapping or block compression on some targets.
Non-finite bounds produce a NaN view matrix in anything that frames the asset.
An asset far larger than expected usually means the export used the wrong unit scale.
A collapsed axis means the mesh is flat or empty, whatever its triangle count says.
A file can parse cleanly and still contain nothing to draw.
